The '''Neshig sector''' lay in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Corvanni system/Legends|Corvanni system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The latter was the site of the astronomical object [[Corvanni IV]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the company [[Gandalom Paramedicinals, Inc.]] had its corporate headquarters in [[Gandalom City]] on Corvanni IV.<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Neshig [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was introduced in the [[1994]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', which was written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="GG10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Corvanni [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
